subject: Vendor activation: PO acceptance & EU VAT handling
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme-retail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@acme-retail.com
Date: 2026-10-12T14:18:00+01:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding — required PO header fields and VAT handling

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for taking this — we're starting vendor activation for Redwood Inference and need a quick confirmation on a few AP requirements so we can complete the portal registration. Attached is our standard AP onboarding packet (see "AP_Onboarding_Packet_Acme_20261012.pdf"). Key items we need from you to finish setup: 

- Legal entity name and VAT / tax ID to appear on invoices (we need the exact string that should appear on the PO and invoice).
- Bank remit details and confirmation whether you support bank validation (we use automated bank file matching).
- For POs: we require the PO header to include Buyer GL Code and Cost Center fields for automatic allocation. Please confirm whether you will accept POs where those fields are empty, or if you can surface them on the invoice.
- VAT handling: do you issue VAT invoices for EU entities or do you prefer a self-billing arrangement? If self-billing, we need the Owning VAT number and a signed self-billing agreement (we can send the DocuSign).
- Preferred invoice formats: PDF or EDI (we accept both; provide sample if XML variant).

Can you send back your vendor form and a sample invoice (PDF) so we can map fields in our portal? If possible, sign the DocuSign vendor activation link in the packet so that we can move to payment terms validation.

Thanks — if you want to jump on a 20-min call tomorrow to review the mapping, I can schedule.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
AP Operations Manager
Acme Retail
[Attachment: AP_Onboarding_Packet_Acme_20261012.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme-retail.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-12T16:04:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — required PO header fields and VAT handling

Hi Elena — thanks for the packet, and welcome. Looping in Laura from Finance and Marissa from Merchant Ops so we can cover legal/tax and portal integration details.

Quick answers up front:
- Legal name for the vendor record: "Redwood Inference Ltd" (for EU/UK invoices).
- VAT/Tax IDs: UK VAT GB999 8888 77 (example; see attached vendor form for the full list of entities).
- Bank remit: we will provide IBAN and SWIFT on the Redwood Vendor Form (attached). We can complete your bank validation form — happy to do an automated file if you provide the spec.
- PO header fields: we can accept POs as-is, but to populate Buyer GL Code and Cost Center on invoices we need to map to our invoice template. We will include both fields on our invoice PDF if your portal mapping requires them.
- VAT approach: Redwood issues VAT invoices for EU-registered entities. We are open to self-billing if Acme prefers — please send the standard self-billing agreement; we can review.

Attached: Redwood_Vendor_Form_20261012.pdf and a sample PDF invoice (sample_invoice_redwood_20261012.pdf).

Next steps:
1) Laura — can you confirm the legal entity strings and VAT numbers to appear on the vendor record?
2) Elena — if you could share the exact XML schema/field names for Buyer GL Code and Cost Center (or a sample PO XML), Marissa will map it into our ingestion pipeline.

I can do a 20-min sync tomorrow at 09:30 CET if that works for everyone.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Form_20261012.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme-retail.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-12T17:22:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — required PO header fields and VAT handling

Hi Elena,

Thanks for the clear list. A few notes from Finance to speed validation: 

- Official invoicing legal names we use: 
  * Redwood Inference Ltd (UK) — VAT: GB999888877
  * Redwood Inference, Inc. (US) — EIN: 12-3456789
  * Redwood Inference GmbH (DE) — VAT: DE123456789
  Please use the exact strings above when creating the vendor record.

- Currency and remit: we accept EUR invoices to our EUR IBAN for EU entities; bank details are on the vendor form. For payment terms, our default is Net 45 unless otherwise agreed in the SOW/MSA.

- Invoicing format: PDF is preferred. If you do an EDI/PEPPOL/XML integration, we can accept UBL/Peppol or a basic PO+Invoice XML. We requested a sample PO XML earlier — that will help Marissa map fields.

- Buyer GL Code / Cost Center: we can include both fields on the invoice PDF in a header block if you require them — please share the field names exactly as they appear in your portal (e.g., buyer_gl_code, cost_center).

- Self-billing: we are open to self-billing for recurring subscription charges. If Acme requires it, please send the self-billing agreement and we will get the required signatures.

I attached a sample invoice (sample_invoice_redwood_20261012.pdf) to show where we place PO number, GL and Cost Center in our template.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sample_invoice_redwood_20261012.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme-retail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@acme-retail.com
Date: 2026-10-13T09:11:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — required PO header fields and VAT handling

Thanks Jordan & Laura — helpful. A few clarifications: 

- Portal needs exact field names for automatic mapping. Our PO XML uses: <BuyerGLCode> and <CostCenter>. Please have Marissa confirm those match her mapping keys.
- Self-billing agreement: sending via DocuSign (link below). We need the owning VAT number for the entity who will be self-billed.
- Bank validation: our treasury team requires a proof-of-bank (bank letter or recent bank statement) to enable automated e-payments. Can you provide a bank letter or the bank details registry PDF?

Attached I've uploaded an example PO (acme_po_sample.xml) so you can test mapping. If you can return a signed vendor form and the bank validation doc, we'll move you to Active status and issue a test PO within 48 hours.

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/someDocId/vendor-activation-Acme

Regards,
Elena Ruiz
AP Operations Manager
Acme Retail
[Attachment: acme_po_sample.xml (application/xml)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme-retail.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-15T09:03:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — required PO header fields and VAT handling

Hi Elena — quick update and next steps: 

1) We completed the Redwood Vendor Form and attached the signed PDF (Redwood_Vendor_Form_20261012.pdf).
2) Laura attached a proof-of-bank extract to the vendor form packet for bank validation (separate secure upload to your treasury portal).
3) Marissa has taken the acme_po_sample.xml and confirmed our mapping keys align to <BuyerGLCode> and <CostCenter>. She will create a test invoice that includes those header fields in the exact tags and run it against your portal during the test PO.

We'll sign the DocuSign self-billing agreement today and return it. Please put us in a test queue for the PO — we'd like to validate invoice ingestion and payables matching on your side.

Marissa, can you schedule the test run and confirm the time window you need?

Thanks everyone — should be straightforward from here.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Form_20261012.pdf (application/pdf)]
